question:
[MCQ] Based on the video clip, the operator adjusts the probe angle while staying in the same general window. What is the most likely purpose of this adjustment?
A. To optimize the insonation angle for Doppler assessment of blood flow across the structure
B. To bring an adjacent anatomic landmark into the field of view to confirm orientation and probe position
C. To reduce artifact (e.g., reverberation or shadowing) by changing the beam incidence while maintaining the same acoustic window
D. To correct foreshortening/incomplete depiction and obtain a more complete long-axis view of the target
groundtruth: The operator changes the probe angle (keeping a subcostal approach and an oblique orientation) to better open up the gallbladder. This improves completeness of the view when a perfectly sagittal alignment would not show the organ well end-to-end.

question:

question:
